PluginData.Author: Taeleus
PluginData.Tooltip: See your ship's layout and spot damaged or missing blocks.
PluginData.Description:
Marigold adds a ship and station display to your HUD. To track missing blocks, first save a baseline of what your ship should look like.
Sit in your main cockpit and type /mg capture in chat. Or type /mg ui, open Baselines, and click Capture this ship twice to confirm. Capture saves the blocks that are present now. If parts are already missing, choose Import blueprint under Baselines to use the complete design.
Choose HD Wireframe or Textured Ship, with CPU and GPU rendering options for Textured Ship. Filter by system or damage state, and add health bars for ship systems, individual blocks or terminal groups.
Open Arrange HUD to drag and resize your display and bars. Save a layout for this ship, set a default or share it with another player. Supports Pulsar Legacy and Interim.
